title: Bad Straining Lid
text: Bad Straining Lid. Mine arrived with a bad straining lid. It did not fit on correctly. Also, I was not a fan of the handle design. I think they're too close the side. I threw this poorly designed pasta cooker in the trash.

product_metadata.title: Pasta N More Microwave Cooker with Strainer, All in 1 Microwave Pasta Cooker, Microwave Rice Cooker and Microwave Egg Cooker for Quick Cooking, Nonstick, Dishwasher Safe, 100% Toxin Free As Seen on Tv
features: Microwave Pasta Cooker: The Pasta N More microwave pasta cooker allows you to effortlessly boil pasta in seconds- Simply place the pasta in the inside the cooker, close clip on the lid, put it in the microwave, and enjoy perfectly cooked pasta without any hassle!
Quick & Perfectly Cooked Pasta: Pasta N More instantly heats up the water to the perfect pasta cooking temperature allowing your pasta to be cooked perfectly and faster.
Attachable Lid and Strainer: Easily strain your pasta with the built-in strainer and pour the pasta out to eat right away or clip the attachable lid and effortlessly store it for later.
Cool Touch Handles: Take the bowl out of the microwave worry free with the cool touch handles – Cool touch handles don’t get hot and remain cool to the touch right out of the microwave.
Dishwasher Safe: Save yourself time and effort when cleaning up after using. Simply throw the cooker in the dishwasher after use for a quick cleanup.
Healthy and Non-Toxic: Keep safe and healthy with Pasta N More – Pasta N More is 100% BPA Free, ensuring an ecofriendly and healthy cooking experience.
Versatile Pasta Cooker: Pasta N More is safe to boil, steam, strain, cook, serve, and store food or pasta all in the cooker.
description: Pasta N More Pasta N More Perfect Non-Stick Pasta Cooker - As Seen On TV - BRAND NEW IN BOX Ensure your pasta cooks properly with this Pasta N More 5-in-1 Perfect Pasta Cooker.  Designed to measure and drain pasta for convenient preparation, this cooker works well for all types of pasta. The cooker features Temperature Technology to provide the exact cooking temperature for pasta, while the cool-touch handles make serving your creations simple and easy. Easily cook pasta right out of the microwave. Use Pasta N more to cook vegetables, poach or boil eggs, cook pasta, and even make smores.  Features: 1.Made from sturdy, non-softening plastic that is microwave and dishwasher safe 2.Boil, strain, cook, serve and store food and pasta. 3.Tight-fitting lids don't dislodge when the container is held upside-down ensuring nothing spills. 4.Internal dimensions: 12.5" L x 5.75" W x 8.5" H 5.Cool-touch handles remain cool to the touch right out of the microwave. 6.Nonstick and Bisphenol A-Free (BPA) for healthier cooking 7.Perfect measuring handles 8.Large capacity pot What’s Included in the Package:  Pasta N More pot unit with water level indicator.  Sieving lid - allows you to empty out water without your pasta spilling out.  Extender Ring - creates an additional top layer allowing 2 food items to be cooked at the same time.  Storing lid is airtight for storing leftover pasta or food.  Pasta n More Perfect Recipe Guide
